title: asperula lutea var. tomentella
intro: Asperula lutea var. tomentella, commonly known as Yellow Wood Sorrel, is a perennial herb belonging to the gentian family (Gentianaceae). This plant is known for its health benefits, particularly in treating digestive issues and urinary tract problems, due to its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Asperula lutea var. tomentella include its ability to stimulate digestion, relieve nausea, and act as a diuretic, making it useful in treating conditions such as dyspepsia and kidney stones. The bioactive constituents of this plant include gentiopicroside, gentiogenin, and gentiobiose, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
